publications.title: Lines on the Map: Causal Effects of City of Atlanta Building Code Amendments on Housing Supply
publications.details: Within metro difference in differences estimating the effects of four City of Atlanta building code amendments (ADU 2019, Stormwater 2020, Impact Fees 2021, Tree 2022) on rents, prices, and permit composition. Comparing thirty in city ZIPs to twenty three adjacent ZIPs in Fulton, DeKalb, Cobb, and Rockdale. Includes an LLM assisted pipeline for extracting amendment metadata directly from municipal ordinances.
publications.venue: Georgia Institute of Technology, School of City and Regional Planning, College of Design. Advisor: Dr. Subhro Guhathakurta.

publications.title: Differentially Private Graph Neural Networks: Shortest Path Approximation
publications.details: Implements DP SGD trained GNNs on grid, wheel, and scale free graphs. Benchmarks path length estimation accuracy, fairness gaps, and robustness under varying privacy budgets.

publications.title: Property Level Analytics Engine for Atlanta Urban Risk Assessment
publications.details: Constructed a tract level database (N=311, more than 118,000 incidents) integrating crime, ACS, and built environment features. Detected strong spatial autocorrelation (Moran's I = 0.559) and trained spatial models.
publications.venue: Center for Urban Resilience and Analytics, Georgia Tech

publications.title: Social Media Crime Sentiment Modeling: A BERT Based Approach
publications.details: Collected more than 200,000 Reddit posts on crime. Built an NLP pipeline with BERT based sentiment classifiers. Produced visualizations revealing negative sentiment spikes on weekday mornings and evenings.

publications.title: Agentic RAG System with NVIDIA NIM and LangChain
publications.details: Engineered an agentic RAG system with NVIDIA NIM hosted LLaMA3 70B, document chunking, and FAISS retrieval. Implemented evaluation harnesses and deployed an interactive demo.

publications.title: Multi Agent RAG Chatbot for Youth Substance Abuse Prevention (1st Place)
publications.details: Led development of a multi agent RAG chatbot integrating retrieval, summarization, and planning agents to produce clinician ready insights.
